cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. What is held instead is central: the Real Estate Tax Authority of the Ministry of Finance collects the real estate tax, a quarter of which is stated as going to local government, with its own app, alongside the Egyptian Tax Authority's e-invoice, e-receipt and real estate transactions systems. A national property identification system of nearly 30 million IDs is held as a survey. Whether any governorate or local unit keeps its own digital revenue record is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. The central and survey systems set the two flags and place nothing.
